rollback_evidence: ExtremeXOS 33.7.1.6-patch1-11 and EXOS 33.6.1.14 are separate firmware scopes. VLAN description and port membership operations require the profile-specific read-back and rollback evidence for the exact firmware and privilege role. Software-image behavior does not establish hardware rollback guarantees. Treat missing or ambiguous clock or configuration-state evidence as unknown and keep write operations blocked. 1.0.12 switch ip routing (X13), measured on EXOS-VM 33.6.1.14 only: ipaddress 'configure vlan V ipaddress A/len' (printed as 'A M'; a primary address is replaced by 'unconfigure vlan V ipaddress', which also disables IPv4 forwarding, then the new address), ipforwarding 'enable|disable ipforwarding vlan V', ipv6-address 'configure vlan V ipaddress P/L' (the first IPv6 address adds the automatic link-local line 'configure vlan V ipaddress eui64 fe80::/64', which only delete vlan removes, so an IPv6 address is set when the VLAN is created, replaced on update or removed with the VLAN; adding or removing it on an existing VLAN is refused), ipforwarding-ipv6 'enable|disable ipforwarding ipv6 vlan V'. Refused before any write: forwarding without the address, an address overlapping another VLAN subnet, a change of the IPv4 address under VRRP or under the gateway of a static route, and a subnet that carries or would take the path of a session client (show session). The check account reads Primary IP, IPv4/IPv6 Forwarding (Enabled or Disabled; a missing row or another value is unverified) and the IPv6 rows of show vlan V. An address with a zone identifier or white space is refused. IP lines outside the profile (a second IPv6 address, the automatic link-local address alone) refuse L3 updates and VLAN deletion. Non-L3 updates preserve all IP lines and verify them in the configuration digest. On another firmware the IP attributes carry firmware_support untested.
